title: Corpse Retriever
description: Adds a command to retrieve lost corpses.
body: Requires Corpse as a dependency. Standalone command version of the /corpse command from the [Tangible Commands](https://modrinth.com/mod/tangible-commands) mod, which adds an item version of this command. This mod adds a command easing the retrieval of corpses that may find themselves in the void, in a wall, or are there, somewhere... The **/corpse** or **/corpseget** commands can be used to teleport the nearest corpse in a range of 50 blocks at the player's current location.   __**Currently added commands:**__ * **/corpse & /corpseget** All of the commands above execute the same thing. They exist for intuitiveness.   Feel free to include in modpacks.
